title: Relaying abduction data such as pain levels

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US agency that intercepts and handles secret communications, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about his work in the early 1990s at a site he calls Base 2. He says the messages he received started to show that they were about abductions, people being taken by the beings, and that he relayed details such as how much pain the people felt. If true, it would mean the government was tracking abductions through a direct channel to non-humans.
